summary.intent: The user wanted a focused review and fix of the `entire explain --generate` path, starting with Codex checkpoint support and then moving later to the Claude-side generation hang/cancel behavior. They also wanted the Codex fix validated, committed, pushed, and reconciled with PR review and CI feedback.
summary.outcome: A Codex-specific `--generate` fix was implemented, tested, committed, and pushed on branch `codex-explain-generate`, with follow-up local fixes for a PR review bug and a lint failure. The Claude-side timeout/cancellation issue was analyzed and clarified, but intentionally deferred to a later change.

repo: `explain --generate` uses agent-specific transcript parsing paths for some agents, but Codex was missing first-class support and fell through to the Claude/Cursor parser.
Codex transcript handling already existed in the compact transcript layer, and reusing that normalization path was the right integration point instead of inventing a second Codex parser.

`CheckpointTranscriptStart` is stored as a raw JSONL line offset, even for Codex sessions; treating it as a response-item index causes mis-scoping on transcripts that contain non-message rows like `event_msg`.

code.finding: The summarizer switch handled Gemini, Droid, OpenCode, and Claude/Cursor but omitted `AgentTypeCodex`, causing Codex transcripts to fall back to the wrong parser.
The fallback Claude/Cursor transcript parser expects `user`/`assistant` lines with `message` payloads, which does not match raw Codex rollout JSONL.
When condensation produces zero entries, `GenerateFromTranscript` returns `transcript has no content to summarize`, which was the direct user-facing symptom for Codex checkpoints.
The compact transcript layer already contained Codex-specific normalization logic, including understanding rollout rows like `session_meta` and `response_item`.
The same Codex omission affected auto-summarization during condensation, not just `explain --generate`.
`explain --generate` invokes summary generation from the explain command and was also responsible for double-wrapping summary errors.
Summary generation defaults to `ClaudeGenerator`; error wrapping in this path made Claude CLI cancellation/hang failures appear as duplicated `failed to generate summary` messages.
Claude summary generation shells out to the user's local `claude` CLI via `exec.CommandContext`, with no dedicated summarization timeout; hangs persist until process exit or parent cancellation.

workflow: The `--generate` flow should be reasoned about in two phases: checkpoint scoping and transcript normalization before any model call happens.
For agent-specific transcript formats, reuse an existing normalization layer if one already exists instead of creating a parallel parser path.
Unit tests caught the initial Codex gap, but real PR feedback exposed a deeper semantic mismatch in offset units that the first implementation got wrong.
Static code review plus targeted tests was enough to diagnose the Claude path as a local CLI subprocess orchestration issue rather than an Entire-owned API call.
CI and bot review comments needed to be separated into semantic bugs versus cosmetic lint so fixes could be scoped correctly.

friction: Codex checkpoints initially failed with `transcript has no content to summarize` because the summarizer parsed them as Claude/Cursor transcripts.
The first Codex implementation reused normalization correctly but initially mismatched compact-transcript output with the summarizer's expected input envelope format.
A follow-up detection bug appeared because scoped Codex transcripts can start at `response_item` and no longer include `session_meta`, so format detection had to accept suffixes.
The first scoping fix misinterpreted `CheckpointTranscriptStart` as response-item-based instead of raw line-based, which Bugbot and Copilot both flagged as a real bug.
Sandbox limitations blocked branch creation and Go build-cache usage, requiring escalated runs for branch operations and test verification.
The Claude-side failure mode was opaque because canceling a hung local `claude` subprocess surfaced as `claude CLI failed (exit -1)` with duplicated wrapping.
CI feedback mixed a real semantic review issue with a separate `goconst` lint failure, which added noise during triage.
open_items: Implement the separate Claude-side `--generate` improvement for hung/canceled local `claude` subprocesses, likely including clearer cancellation handling and possibly an explicit timeout.
Commit and push the final follow-up local changes for PR #875 that addressed the review-comment semantic bug and remaining lint issue, if that had not yet completed after the transcript ended.
Consider whether the Droid `explain` scoping path also needs more explicit agent-aware handling, since it was noted as less explicit than Gemini/OpenCode/Codex.
Evaluate whether the Codex-related fix in `explain --generate` should be mirrored or further validated in all other summarization/condensation paths that consume checkpoint transcripts.
